name: engine
title: Engine
description: The pencil box every scene draws with: seeded randomness and noise, geometry, fields, ink and paper, the stage and loop, the quality governor, the sun and what it casts, things that lag and ring, fronts that cross a field, and a small WebGL helper.

budget.reason: Raised from 53,248 for light.js, motion.js and wave.js. All three are opt-in by import, so a scene pays only for what it names: mithagar draws on rng, math and color, 4,483 B of it. This figure is the whole pencil box, not a per-scene cost.
